Unit System

Contents

  • Creating a unit system
  • Supported units
  • Conversion helpers

Unit System#

UnitSystem declares the physical units used when defining a PMD model. The solver always works in SI internally; this object drives display conversions and plot axis labels.

Creating a unit system#

from pmd.core import UnitSystem

us = UnitSystem(length='mm', force='N', angle='deg')

Pass it to PlanarMultibodyModel:

model = PlanarMultibodyModel(bodies=[...], joints=[...], units=us)

Supported units#

Dimension

Choices

Default

length

"m", "mm", "cm", "in", "ft"

"m"

force

"N", "kN", "lbf"

"N"

angle

"rad", "deg"

"rad"

Conversion helpers#

us = UnitSystem(length='mm', force='N', angle='deg')

factor = us.to_si('length')   # 0.001  (mm → m)
label  = us.latex_unit('length')  # r'\mathrm{mm}'
moment = us.moment_unit        # 'N·mm'
